_catatan: Preset gaya komik (owner 2026-11-15). Terinspirasi genre komik terkenal, tetapi prompt tidak menyebut merek, judul, atau tokoh milik penerbit (Marvel, DC, Tintin, dsb.) supaya hasil tidak meniru karya berhak cipta dan tidak ditolak filter. 'wajib' selalu ditambahkan di setiap prompt (faceless, tanpa teks, ruang balon). 'prompt' = gaya gambar Artistly v6. 'render' = tampilan balon dan halaman di komik-render.py. kartun-klasik, minimalis-doodle, retro-pop-art diadaptasi dari dokumen preset-produksi-komik (owner 2026-11-15); bagian ekspresi wajah dokumen itu sengaja dibuang dan diganti gestur karena aturan faceless.
wajib: Every visible human face is a perfectly smooth uninterrupted blank skin-tone surface from forehead to chin, with absolutely no eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, nostrils, mouth or lips, not a mask; emotions shown only through body language and posture. Heads upright, nobody lying down, no close-up of faces. Hands with five natural fingers. No Prophet, no angels, no depictions of the unseen. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signage, no watermarks, no logos. Vertical 9:16 composition with full bodies visible, characters in the lower two thirds, a calm uncluttered area in the upper third reserved for speech balloons.
wajib_kosong: Pure landscape and architecture scene only. The image contains absolutely no humans, no human-like figures, no characters, no crowds, no children, no babies, no dolls, no statues, no silhouettes, no living beings at all. No Prophet, no angels, no depictions of the unseen. No text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no captions, no signage, no watermarks, no logos. Vertical 9:16 composition.

3d-animasi.prompt: Vibrant premium stylized 3D animated children's comic panel, soft rounded shapes, warm cinematic lighting, rich saturated colors, clean readable composition.

superhero-amerika.prompt: 2D comic book art in the classic American superhero comic style, NOT 3D, NOT painterly: thick bold black ink outlines, heavy spot blacks, Ben-Day halftone dot shading, flat vivid primary colors red blue yellow, dramatic low camera angle, punchy rim lighting, printed comic page look.
superhero-amerika.akhir: Art style reminder: flat 2D inked comic book panel with bold black outlines and halftone dots, vintage four-color print.

manga.prompt: Black-and-white Japanese manga panel, monochrome ink drawing only, absolutely no color anywhere (clothes, skin, sky and ground all in grayscale): crisp clean pen lines, gray screentone dot shading, dramatic speed lines in the background, high contrast black and white.
manga.akhir: Art style reminder: pure monochrome manga ink with screentones, grayscale only, zero color.

ligne-claire.prompt: European ligne claire comic illustration, uniform clean outlines of equal weight, flat bright colors without heavy shading, highly detailed clear backgrounds, gentle daylight, classic adventure album look.

komik-indonesia-klasik.prompt: Classic 1970s Indonesian printed comic illustration, hand-inked brush lines, cross-hatching, muted vintage print colors, slightly faded paper texture, nostalgic village atmosphere.

webtoon.prompt: Modern Korean webtoon digital illustration, soft cel shading, clean thin lineart, gentle pastel gradients, luminous soft lighting, polished romantic slice-of-life look.

chibi-anak.prompt: Cute chibi cartoon illustration for young children, oversized round heads on small bodies, thick soft rounded outlines, bright cheerful pastel colors, simple playful backgrounds.

kisah-3d-dewasa.inspirasi: film animasi 3D sinematik untuk keluarga; owner 2026-11-16: postur dewasa harus proporsional, jangan seperti anak-anak
kisah-3d-dewasa.prompt: Cinematic stylized 3D animated film still, realistic ADULT human proportions: head about one seventh of total body height, adult torso, broad shoulders, long arms and long legs, mature adult bodies, NOT chibi, NOT big heads, NOT toddler or child bodies, NOT babies. Rich natural lighting, detailed textures, epic cinematic composition.
kisah-3d-dewasa.akhir: Proportion reminder: every adult has realistic adult anatomy with a small head relative to a tall body, like adults in a cinematic animated film, never childlike.

kisah-3d-boneka.nama: Kisah 3D Boneka (standar video kisah JOTA mulai 2026-11-17)
kisah-3d-boneka.inspirasi: owner 2026-11-17: 3D boneka, badan proporsional, jangan botak. Pengganti kisah-3d-dewasa: gaya realistis membuat VideoExpress melengkapi wajah (Qabil-Habil SHOT12-R2 17/20 kepala berwajah).
kisah-3d-boneka.prompt: Premium stylized 3D animated family film still. Characters look like smooth handcrafted vinyl dolls: matte soft skin, simplified rounded shapes, no realistic skin detail, no visible muscles. ADULT doll proportions: head about one sixth of total body height, adult torso, shoulders, long arms and long legs, NOT chibi, NOT big heads, NOT child bodies. Every man wears a cloth head covering that hides all of his hair. Warm cinematic lighting, rich saturated colors, clean composition.
kisah-3d-boneka.akhir: Style reminder: smooth stylized 3D doll characters with adult proportions and blank doll faces, every head covered by cloth.

kartun-klasik.inspirasi: kartun koran klasik; pilihan awal komik humor IG (preset-produksi-komik owner 2026-11-15)
kartun-klasik.prompt: 2D classic newspaper cartoon illustration, NOT 3D: rounded simple character shapes about four heads tall, clean medium-weight black outlines with rounded ends, warm flat colors (cream, mustard yellow, orange, soft blue) with at most one shade level, elastic expressive gestures and squash-and-stretch poses, simple readable background, clear comedic staging, medium shot.
kartun-klasik.akhir: Art style reminder: flat 2D newspaper cartoon, clean outlines, warm flat colors, minimal shading; emotion only through big body gestures.

minimalis-doodle.inspirasi: komik doodle gambar tangan; humor singkat, produksi cepat
minimalis-doodle.prompt: Minimal hand-drawn doodle comic panel, NOT 3D: simple rounded figures with very simple bodies and limbs, slightly imperfect black ink strokes on a plain cream background, only one accent color (warm orange) in the whole image, no shading, no gradients, only the essential props, generous empty negative space.
minimalis-doodle.akhir: Art style reminder: minimal black doodle lines on cream, one orange accent color, no shading; characters told apart by hair, clothes and accessories.

retro-pop-art.inspirasi: komik iklan vintage; poster, merch, visual promosi
retro-pop-art.prompt: 2D vintage pop-art comic illustration, NOT 3D: bold thick black contours, limited palette of red, yellow, blue, black and cream only, Ben-Day dot halftone shading, large flat graphic color shapes, subtle offset-print texture, theatrical poses, radial sunburst background on dramatic moments.
retro-pop-art.akhir: Art style reminder: retro pop-art print, thick outlines, Ben-Day dots, red yellow blue black cream only, no soft gradients.
